title: Sampled histogram delta encoder for inference KPIs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a loss-minimizing histogram delta encoder that preserves sampling semantics and exemplar trace links when converting OTLP histogram snapshots from inference nodes into compact Prometheus remote_write-friendly timeseries. This ticket covers the sidecar adapter and the ingest-time reconciler that ensures monotonicity, idempotency, and exemplar provenance for high-cardinality inference KPIs (latency, token counts, queue time).
acceptance_criteria: Adapter produces delta-encoded histogram series that reduce payload by >= 60% compared to naïve full-snapshot remote_write for representative workloads without increasing tail-latency error by > 2%
Exemplar trace IDs and span_context are preserved and searchable from the resulting Prometheus-compatible series and link back to traces in the tracing backend
Decoder in ingestion plane replays deltas idempotently after retries and handles out-of-order arrival without metric value corruption
Automated unit and integration tests cover: sampled vs unsampled histograms, cold-start counters, and multi-tenant label explosion scenarios
Perf benchmark harness shows <5% CPU overhead on the adapter at 10k metrics/s with typical batch sizes
tasks: Design delta encoding format for OTLP histogram snapshots (proto version + migration notes)
Implement sidecar encoder in telemetry-adapter service with feature flag rollout
Add exemplar propagation: attach trace/span IDs to exemplar buckets and wire into OTLP export
Server-side decoder/aggregator: apply deltas, dedupe, and emit stable monotonic series to downstream storage
Create unit tests for encoding/decoding, edge cases (counter resets, wraparound), and sampling boundaries
Run performance tests on dedicated infra and collect CPU/memory/ingest-latency metrics
Update Console dashboards to display delta-encoding savings and exemplar link actions
Document migration path and rollback plan for customers using private deployments
blockers: Need final decision on exemplar storage schema from tracing team (awaiting Tracing RFC review)
Regression tests for Prometheus remote_write consumer need infra quota approval

notes: Goal is pragmatic: reduce network and storage cost for high-cardinality histogram workloads from Dedicated and Private customers while preserving traceability to individual requests for debugging high-tail latency events.
We intentionally avoid lossy sketching for primary metrics; delta-encoding + sampling-awareness keeps bucket fidelity while compressing repeated snapshots.
Implementation should be opt-in behind a tenant-level feature flag for first rollouts. Private deployments will receive opt-in upgrade instructions.
